info.name: International Payment - Status Check (External / Stripe Provider)

request.description:
Checks payment completion status directly from the Stripe provider.

Fill in `application_no` query param with your reference_id before sending.

Response: `response_data: true` means payment completed, `false` means still pending.

Known response codes:
- `0000` — success
- `4000` / `4001` / `4002` — validation error
